shared_elements: roughly horizontal band or ridge of relief
justification: Both are worn stone carvings whose ornament is executed in very shallow relief with incised outlines, and each contains a disc-like circular motif and a horizontal ridged band, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a free-standing, roughly anthropomorphic monolith with abstract, symmetrical geometric markings on a rounded volume, whereas B is a flat slab panel bearing a naturalistic recumbent quadruped and the legs of a larger figure, so subject matter and format differ fundamentally.
